# Mibnews

> Delivering the latest breaking news and top stories across politics, entertainment, sports, and business from India and around the world, in Hindi and English.

Mibnews is a bilingual Hindi and English digital news publisher covering national and international news, sports, entertainment, breaking news, live TV, and short-form video.

## Sections

- [Latest News](https://www.mibnews.in/latest)
- [Breaking News](https://www.mibnews.in/breaking)
- [National News](https://www.mibnews.in/national)
- [World News](https://www.mibnews.in/world)
- [Entertainment](https://www.mibnews.in/entertainment)
- [Sports](https://www.mibnews.in/sports)
- [Videos](https://www.mibnews.in/videos)
- [Live TV](https://www.mibnews.in/live-tv)
- [Short Posts](https://www.mibnews.in/short-posts)
- [Reels](https://www.mibnews.in/reels)

## About and legal

- [Contact](https://www.mibnews.in/contact)
- [Careers](https://www.mibnews.in/career)

Article pages at `/article/:slug` are the site's primary citable content units.

- Domain: https://www.mibnews.in
- Languages: Hindi and English
